title: Symptom Visit Brief
user: A person with intermittent or hard-to-explain symptoms who needs to turn brief daily observations into a factual timeline a clinician can review.
smallest_useful_product: A local-first daily check-in with symptom, severity, duration, trigger/context, and optional photo; it renders a date-bounded one-page PDF/CSV visit brief with plain counts and trends.
constraints: Keep records on device by default; make exports explicit; avoid medical-device claims and diagnostic scoring; accessible severity controls are required.
